# OPTIMUS PROJECTS - CIVIL CONTRACTOR SERVICES

Optimus Projects is a professional civil contractor and construction services firm based in Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra, India. We specialize in comprehensive civil contractor services for residential and commercial projects.

## CIVIL CONTRACTOR SERVICES

Our expertise as a civil contractor includes:

### Structural Work
- RCC (Reinforced Cement Concrete) work
- Structural design and execution
- Load-bearing wall construction
- Foundation work
- Beam and slab construction
- Expert plastering and finishing

### Waterproofing Solutions
- Roof waterproofing
- Bathroom and kitchen waterproofing
- Basement waterproofing
- Polyurethane coatings
- Epoxy membrane application
- Preventive maintenance

### Electrical Services
- Wiring and circuit installation
- Power distribution systems
- Lighting design and installation
- Safety systems and earthing
- Load calculation and planning

### Plumbing Services
- Water supply piping
- Drainage system design
- Fixtures installation (taps, flush, pipes)
- Hot water systems
- Leak detection and repair

### Painting & Finishing
- Interior and exterior painting
- Decorative finishes
- Surface preparation
- Quality coating systems
- Color consultation

### Tiling & Flooring
- Ceramic and porcelain tiling
- Marble and stone flooring
- Anti-slip solutions
- Grout sealing
- Professional installation

### Interior & Exterior Design
- Space planning
- Material selection
- 3D visualization
- Aesthetic implementation
- Modern and traditional designs

### Complete Renovation Services
- End-to-end project management
- Simultaneous multi-service coordination
- Timeline adherence
- Cost optimization
- Quality assurance
